carrier_degree_audit.selection: NONE: no independently justified coupling selects one m

conditional_theorem.hypothesis: For some m, independently prove that one primary step occupies one new Bm state without skip/repeat and that a_n=k exactly encodes completed capacity Bm(k) with Bm(k+1) not yet complete.
conditional_theorem.precollapse_retyping: Only under this proved coupling may n^(1/m) be introduced as the associated algebraic threshold readout.
conditional_theorem.proof: |Bm(k)|=k^m and |Bm(k+1)|=(k+1)^m; completed/saturated lower carrier needs at least k^m occupied states and incomplete upper carrier has fewer than (k+1)^m.
